description.value: A family-run motel nestled in the UNESCO Global Geopark in the remote community of Tumbler Ridge in Northern BC, offering a rare concentration of on-site amenities for such a remote location. The property includes a café and dining room, the Coal Bin Pub, an attached liquor store, pet-friendly rooms, kitchenettes, and an on-site hair salon. Touring cyclists riding through Northern BC will find it a well-equipped stop with access to world-class hiking, fishing, and wildlife viewing in the surrounding wilderness.

address.value: 275 Southgate St, Tumbler Ridge, BC V0C 2W0
